title: P18 exit and Quntal v0.3 computer-use readiness
objective: Close QUNTAL-P18 only after every authorized browser, transfer, exact-window capture, structured desktop, coordinate fallback, model-adapter, and remote computer-use surface is live-qualified, every intentionally denied authority remains regression-proven unreachable, the authoritative tool/profile/parity contracts match shipped discovery exactly, and release artifacts pass Quntal's normal evidence-first qualification.

include: program-wide capability/parity matrix mapping each computer-use shape to live exposed, live hidden/local-only, intentionally denied, or not shipped status with exact reason

exact tool/profile/OAuth/remote-scope/discovery reconciliation across core, browser_structured, desktop observation/capture, structured desktop control, coordinate fallback, and explicit computer_use unions
end-to-end local workflows covering real browser navigation/observation/actuation/transfers and real Windows observation/capture/structured actuation/coordinate fallback
end-to-end authorized remote workflows proving exact lease isolation where SG-000084 enables reach

denial proofs for arbitrary JS/CDP, unrestricted shell/script, generic socket/proxy, personal browser profile, raw model-to-input, remote approval/self-grant, security-dialog automation, silent elevation, silent coordinate fallback, and generic filesystem widening

release packaging verification for browser-host/provider components, supported browser detection, quntal doctor output, dependency locks, licenses/notices, SBOM, provenance, reproducibility, installer/update/rollback, and no runtime dynamic code fetch

exact-head CI, real-Windows qualification, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual excluded-file review, security/privacy review, zero unresolved blocking threads, merge, and post-merge canonical verification
exclude: new feature/authority widening beyond the already qualified P18 surfaces
claims of support for unqualified OS/browser/provider combinations

invariants: no tool/profile/remote scope exceeds its live-qualified provider authority
all intentionally denied authority remains explicitly documented and regression-tested
release artifacts contain only pinned/reviewed dependencies and no runtime latest/dynamic donor fetch

acceptance.claim: Every authorized local and remote computer-use workflow runs end to end through Quntal's own tool surface and kernel against live providers, with exact parity/tool/profile records matching shipped discovery.

Every denied authority class remains unreachable in source and behavior regressions, including arbitrary JS/CDP, unrestricted shell/script, generic sockets/proxy, personal profiles, raw model-to-input, remote approval/self-grant, protected/security surfaces, silent elevation, and silent coordinate fallback.

Release qualification proves pinned browser-host/provider packaging, supported browser detection/doctor behavior, dependency locks, licenses/notices, SBOM/provenance, reproducibility, installer/update/rollback, and no runtime dynamic code fetch.

Exact-head CI, real-Windows qualification, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual excluded-file review, security/privacy review, zero unresolved blocking threads, normal merge, and post-merge verification all pass on the canonical revision.

successor_requirements.post_p18: Any capability beyond the qualified Quntal v0.3 computer-use surface requires a new program/grain and must not be inferred from donor functionality or model support.

done_when: QUNTAL-P18 is exited canonically and Quntal v0.3 is ready with live, bounded, provider-neutral governed computer use and all non-authorized donor/raw authority still unreachable.
